_comment: QUESTION: Does a floor that is 1-2 cells tighter on a quarter of emissions pay for a third more territory time, at equal wall clock?
READS OUT: refineMovedLo, refineInverted, worstWallMs, decisions, score

DESIGN NOTE: The BASE arm must be enum-on, not off: the refiner requires the enumeration, so an off-vs-refine pair measures their sum. A cell that never exercises a held teammate will never move the `hi` channel — build the arm knowing that.
FLAG-VALUE TRAP: every CL flag parses only `1`, `on` or `true`, with no
warning on anything else. Set the OFF arm by OMITTING the variable, and
check the manifest envAtRun block afterwards. Since the CL7 telemetry
closure the per-game rows also carry the RESOLVED flag stamp, which is
the value that actually ran — read that, not the environment.
